attempts.summary: Built a 4-node MariaDB Galera cluster on RHEL9 nodes node1-node4. Bootstrapped a 3-node cluster on node1/node2/node3 (mariadb-server-galera 10.5.29 from RHEL AppStream), created application database appdb.orders with data, then added node4 as a fourth member which received the existing dataset via rsync SST and began accepting writes like the other members. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot IDs and cluster health on all 4 nodes, then restarted node4, node3, node2, and node1 one at a time (preserving 3-of-4 quorum throughout), confirming a changed boot_id and full cluster/data recovery (wsrep_cluster_size=4, Synced, wsrep_ready=ON, appdb.orders intact) after each. Verified with a final cross-node write/read check post-restart-cycle.
